exposure: macrosomia in the absence of diabetes
active management (elective delivery for macrosomia between 38+0 and 40+6 weeks' gestation)
expectant management (with induction of labour offered after 41 weeks' gestation)
outcome: Cervical favorability at induction of labor
cohort: 397 women with estimated fetal weight over 4000 g after 37 weeks' gestation, excluding those with diabetes, previous caesarean section, non-cephalic presentation, or other complicating conditions
finding: There was no difference in major maternal or neonatal outcomes between active and expectant management of fetal macrosomia.
mod_finding: Inducing nulliparous women with an unfavorable cervix for non-diabetic macrosomia was associated with increased risk of anal sphincter injury and postpartum hemorrhage.
